name: implement-decision-doc-promotion
title: Implement decision document promotion commands
description: Implement the first version of the controlled decision-doc promotion workflow described by B-16eb: create story-local decision_doc_proposal artifacts, render read-only previews, and save accepted proposals into docs/requirements/decisions/*.md with scope and freshness checks.
